Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V9-L-scarif-2022-07-10-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V9-L-scarif-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V9-L-scarif-2022-07-10-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V9-L-scarif.gif]], 10 July 2022).
